Package service

Class AbstractService<ID,E extends Entity<ID>,R extends Repository<ID,E>>

java.lang.Object
service.AbstractService<ID,E,R>
Type Parameters:
ID - the type of the entity id
E - the type of the entity
R - the type of the repository that stores the entities
Direct Known Subclasses:
FriendshipService, UserService
public abstract class AbstractService<ID,E extends Entity<ID>,R extends Repository<ID,E>> extends Object
Base class for services that add and remove entities, using the Template Method pattern. The steps of add(Entity) and remove(Object) are fixed here; subclasses only fill in the hooks checkBeforeAdd(Entity) and beforeRemove(Object).

The service depends only on the repository interface, never on a concrete implementation. The entity's own data is validated by the repository when it is saved; the service checks the rules that need other data (uniqueness, related entities).

    • checkBeforeAdd

      protected abstract void checkBeforeAdd(E entity)
      Hook called by add(Entity) before the entity is saved. Subclasses check here the rules that depend on other data (uniqueness, related entities existing), and throw an exception if the entity cannot be added. The entity has not been validated yet, so implementations must accept null fields.
      Parameters:
      entity - the entity about to be added

    • beforeRemove

      protected void beforeRemove(ID id)
      Hook called by remove(Object) after the entity is known to exist and before it is deleted. Subclasses clean up here any data that depends on the entity. The default does nothing.
      Parameters:
      id - the id of the entity about to be removed

    • add

      public final E add(E entity)
      Adds an entity: checks the business rules, then saves it (the repository validates it).
      Parameters:
      entity - the entity to add
      Returns:
      the saved entity
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if the entity is not valid
      DuplicateEntityException - if the entity conflicts with existing data
      EntityNotFoundException - if an entity it refers to does not exist
      RepositoryException - if the entity cannot be persisted
